title: AMS Easy Coordinates
body:
![AMS Easy Coordinates](https://i.postimg.cc/90WgyYKY/MUTE-Title-1.png)

**AMS Easy Coordinates** gives you quick access to your in-game XYZ coordinates right on the screen. It also allows you to quickly share your coordinates with other players via chat.

![Base feature](https://i.postimg.cc/hj4wQ7vm/Screenshot-1.png)

It is intentionally simple: no minimap, no waypoints, no server requirement, and no multiplayer chat spam. Toggle the display on or off, choose where it appears at the top of the screen, and adjust the text size through the generated client config.

**Features:**

*   Client-side coordinates HUD.
*   Toggleable display.
*   Top-left, top-center, and top-right placement.
*   Configurable text size.
*   Hidden while the debug/F3 screen is open.
*   No server install required.

**Note:**

Verions below 2.0.0 of AMS Easy Coordinates allowed players to share coordinates through chat. That feature has been removed on 2.0.0+ so this mod can stay focused on a clean client-side HUD. If you want multiplayer location pings, install [AMS Pings](https://modrinth.com/mod/ams-pings), which is built for richer player, block, and item pinging.

If you enjoy this mod, consider [supporting my work](https://www.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=https://buymeacoffee.com/alexmsa).
